findings.what:
MORNING TABLE v1 (mechanical, first matching row; the only levers are K, SEC n2a, DIS 2.25 and CI; READMIT < 0.94, TAU 0.7 and DIS 1.75 stay out, since picking 1.75 after a 2.25 read would be public fitting).
CODES: '+' = display >= REF + 0.001, '0' = equal, '-' = below. P = exp89p vs exp85a (0.958). Q = exp89q vs exp85a. Q>=P compares the two displays. Rr = exp89r vs display(exp87a). C51 = probe 51 by the R25-A1 (4) codes.
BRANCH A (C51 = '+' or '0u': CI adds on K; the night stack is exp89r).
 M1 (CI, by 11:45 MSK / 08:45Z):
  A1: P '+' -> exp89l_k2cap6_k_sec_ci (K + SEC + CI). This stacks the three levers that read '+' and is the DIS-free neighbour of exp89r, so exp89r vs exp89l isolates DIS.
  A2: P '0', P '-', or P pending at the 08:40Z header -> exp89t_k2cap6_k_dis225_ci (K + DIS 2.25 + CI). This is the SEC-free neighbour of exp89r, and as a non-SEC file it is eligible for either finals slot.
 M2 (non-CI, decide at the first header with exp89r terminal, latest 14:00 MSK / 11:00Z; submit by 14:30 MSK / 11:30Z):
  A3: Rr '0'/'-' and P '+' -> exp89u_k2cap4_k (cap-4 + K hedge, R26M-5). SEC is good there, so DIS is the loser.
  A4: otherwise (Rr '+'; or Rr '0'/'-' with P <= '0'; or exp89r still pending at 11:00Z) -> exp89s_k2cap6_k_dis225 (K + DIS). It is the clean one-lever DIS read on the K base, the CI-free and SEC-free twin of exp89t.
BRANCH B (C51 = '0', '-' or '?': CI does not add on K; the night stack is exp89q). M1 becomes a NON-CI file, because a K+CI stack has no support after a non-additive or negative read (W4 AMEND 2 (3) non-additive stop). The two non-CI files go >= 40 min apart (R18-A7).
 M1 (non-CI, at the first header with Q and P terminal, latest 11:40 MSK / 08:40Z):
  B1: Q < P (both read; DIS hurts on K+SEC) -> exp89u_k2cap4_k.
  B2: otherwise, including P pending -> exp89s_k2cap6_k_dis225 (K + DIS without SEC). It is the SEC-free version of the night stack and splits SEC from DIS.
 M2 (non-CI, >= 40 min after M1, by 14:30 MSK / 11:30Z):
  B3: M1 = exp89s -> exp89u_k2cap4_k. If C51 = '-', also put the CI-risk flag on every CI file on the finals card (R25-A1 (5) spirit).
  B4: M1 = exp89u -> UNUSED, or an E10 copy on the user's explicit yes for that notebook. Every non-CI stack of levers read '+' is then already scored (exp85a, exp89p).
FALLBACKS: if the chosen file's dummy has not PASSED -> the other file of the same row pair (A1<->A2; A3<->A4; B1<->B2), else unused. Every morning read enters the finals card as a public-only, single-embryo read. A SEC file (exp89l) may only be V_pub (Q3). exp89s, exp89t and exp89u may take either slot.

findings.what: The DIS 2.25 direction has a weakly NEGATIVE old-lab prior. exp13 on the old v2.1 pipeline (48 local videos) scored ILP_DISAPPEARANCE_WEIGHT 1 / 2 / 3 at 0.9149 / 0.9158 / 0.9110. A quadratic through these points gives f(2.25) - f(2) = -0.0007 and f(1.75) - f(2) = +0.0003. The metric-formula argument behind the risk stack (-0.73% nodes -> ~+0.0007 node-count bonus) points the other way, so the net prior for DIS 2.25 is ~0 +- 0.001. Caveats: the old pipeline had no motion relink; the lab has been wrong in sign for division knobs; the argument does not change the user-confirmed night. It does mean that every DIS-containing file (exp89q/r/s/t) carries an unread lever with no positive evidence apart from the formula.
